facts.text: The product is Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress, described in the page title as having 1 lakh+ Airknit fibres, latex and adjustable firmness.
Selected variant: Queen, 78 x 60 (198 cm x 152 cm), height 8 (20.3 cm).
The product title explicitly identifies a combination of Airknit fibres and latex.

Airboost is described as Duroflex’s proprietary open-matrix mattress technology, made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres and designed to improve airflow, movement response and postural support.
The mattress has a reversible latex topper with firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other.
Flipping the mattress switches between its two firmness levels.
The zipper cover is designed to be removable and to help identify each side.

The mattress features a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex; the page describes it as providing responsive support, breathability and pressure relief while keeping the sleeper cool through the night.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings should be used to increase durability.
The product page states “100 nights trial.”
The product page also states that the mattress comes with a “100 day sleep trial period.” The trial duration/unit remains unresolved against the 100-nights wording.
The product page displays “10-Years Warranty”; warranty duration is unverified because the supplied product evidence also gives variant-dependent warranty durations.
Airboost mattresses are described as having a long-term manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects and material issues under normal use conditions.
“Trusted by Indian Society of Sleep Research”
“to enhance N3 sleep” is an outcome claim and is not established here as a supported product benefit.
“NHA Accreditation Exclusively approved by doctors at NHA”
